acceptance_criteria.description: The SDK and API version are pinned and the sandbox template or image identity is content-addressed
Only environment-variable names and credential digests enter records
Network-policy activation-usage-and-artifact-export receipts are independently verifiable
Timeout-retry-resume-and-destroy behavior preserves every terminal attempt
The adapter remains exploratory until standalone verifier support for its network boundary is closed

objective: Add an optional E2B backend through the existing adapter capability boundary, with secret-free provider binding, sandbox identity, network observation, durable artifact export, teardown receipts, and recovery tests.
title: Implement a digest-bound E2B sandbox backend adapter
